title: done calls a cancelled required child Open and suggests claiming it
outcome: The completion reminder names the child's real lifecycle (cancelled or superseded) and the exact waiver command
acceptance: a test proves that done on a parent with a cancelled required child prints the cancelled lifecycle and a runnable waiver command instead of 'Open' and 'claim'
